snippet.title: Death by Scrolling Official Release Date Trailer | Launches October 28, 2025
snippet.description:
Keep scrolling… it might save your life.

Death by Scrolling is a fast-paced roguelite packed with chaotic combat, sharp humor, and endless replayability.
Battle bizarre monsters, collect power-ups, and dodge death itself as you fight your way through an ever-changing pixelated purgatory.

Launches October 28, 2025
Coming soon on Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch
Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773590/Death_by_Scrolling/
